distribution_model.detail: Places and operates its gaming terminals inside partner bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops and fraternal venues; also sells games in some states.

notes: Business-to-business route-operator; consumers play terminals in partner venues, so price position and distribution categories are approximate.

purchase_frequency.detail: Players use gaming terminals at their discretion when visiting local venues.
